rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for disagreement or resistance to a proposal, person, or action.

example.english: I have opposition to this rent increase proposal.
example.traditional: 我對呢個加租建議有反對意見。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gaa1 zou1 gin3 ji5 jau5 faan2 deoi3 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this for the political party, faction, or movement opposing the government or ruling party.

example.english: In the Legislative Council, the opposition demanded that the government withdraw the bill.
example.traditional: 立法會入面，反對派要求政府撤回條例。
example.jyutping: lap6 faat3 wui2 jap6 min6 faan2 deoi3 paai3 jiu1 kau4 zing3 fu2 cit3 wui4 tiu4 lai6

rows.note: Use this for the opposing side or pole in a contrast, rather than active resistance to a proposal.

example.english: In this debate, the two sides are in opposition.
example.traditional: 喺呢場爭論入面，兩邊企喺對立面。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 coeng4 zaang1 leon6 jap6 min6 loeng5 bin1 kei5 hai2 deoi3 lap6 min6
